clauses.statement: OutcomeCase create/read/evaluate API は、成果・制約・Info SSOT RACI で解決した closure authority/provenance・参照・参照解決状態・追記専用 evaluation history・評価時点の外部状態/失敗境界/結果 revision/status・時刻を OutcomeCase 専用 record として扱い、既存 RunReceipt v1 schema を変更しない。request は closure authority を自己申告できない。

test_refs.case: creates the required control-plane record with an explicit external state

clauses.statement: closed は technical confirmed、初回から保持された全参照 RunReceipt confirmed、external readback confirm、constraints satisfied、project/capability confirmed、authoritative RACI authority confirmed、認証済み actor の同時成立でのみ導出する。評価 payload は既存 RunReceipt ref を削除できず、各 retained ref を診断する。

test_refs.case: retains every previously stored receipt ref, appends the evaluation history, and diagnoses all retained refs before close
wires the authenticated route actor into actual service-layer closure authority

test_pattern.must_cover: retains every previously stored receipt ref, appends the evaluation history, and diagnoses all retained refs before close

clauses.statement: HTTP 200、テスト、保存、デプロイ、欠落 receipt、external no_data、unknown constraints は close の証拠へ自動変換しない。

test_refs.case: does not close from technical evidence when receipt readback is unconfirmed

clauses.statement: authoritative project/capability/RACI resolver が未解決、registry 未適用、access-context/query 例外、または利用不能なら理由付き unresolved を保存し、close を禁止する。request の evaluator 文字列と authority は認可根拠にしない。repository read/update と table RLS は actor project scope を越えない。

test_refs.case: fails closure authority closed when access context failure
persists unavailable authoritative closure authority and forbids close
rejects self-declared closure authority and cross-project reads or evaluations

clauses.statement: OutcomeCase schema と project RLS は established Info SSOT idempotent apply bundle、post-commit readback、transaction-local negative smoke に登録される。本 Story は Graph write、production migration、deploy を実行しない。

test_refs.case: runs schema, RLS, readback and smoke in fail-closed single-transaction mode

open_questions.question: production migration and Graph entity lifecycle remain explicitly outside v1 local implementation evidence
